title: Moving three customers to Net 30 keeps their limits and shows a toast
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves the three customers on a term of its own to Net 30.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-08 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-08 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-08 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-08 Charlie.
  • Before you start, Net 30's Customers count reads {Count-A} (write it down).
    For example: {Count-A} is 40.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 3 Customers".
  5. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  6. Open {Customer-C}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: no line about credit limits shows.
  • Step 4: no confirmation opens. The window closes, a green toast shows "3 customers moved to Net 30.", {Term-A}'s Customers count reads 0 (3 − 3) and Net 30's reads {Count-A} + 3 (for example 43).
  • Step 5: the "Credit term" reads Net 30 and the credit limit is still $500.00.
  • Step 6: the "Credit term" reads Net 30 and the credit limit is still $1,000.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S4-R17: “When "Move To" is any other term, no confirmation opens, and each moved customer's credit limit stays as it was.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Customers moved | "{n} customers moved to {term}." / "1 customer moved to {term}." | Success toast”
  • Goals: “Moving any number of customers from one term to another takes one window and one confirm, plus one confirmation when the move sets credit limits to $0.”
  • Terminology: “Make Default vs Move Customers → Make Default changes only which term new customers start on. Move Customers changes the term of existing customers the user picks. Neither does the other's job.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
